_provenance.description: Stage-2 (DiffKT) hyperparameters. Copy this file, fill in the marked fields, and pass the values on the command line, e.g. `python diff_prelstm_as2.py --data_name assist0910 --diffusion_steps 100 ...`.
_provenance.values_source: Manuscript Section 5.1.3 (Implementation Details and Evaluation Metrics) and the argparse defaults in diff_prelstm_as2.py.
_provenance.note: diffusion_steps (S) and the noise-schedule bounds (beta_start, beta_end) were selected by Bayesian search on the held-out 20% tuning partition, over S in {50,100,200,500,1000} and (beta_min, beta_max) in [0.001, 0.8]. Replace the placeholders below with the values actually selected for each dataset. The manuscript recommends S = 100 for deployment.

_ablation_notes.wo_normal: true removes the LayerNorm pair in the denoising network
_ablation_notes.wo_kloss: true removes the KT prediction loss (d_loss-only objective)
_ablation_notes.diff_type: set to "noise" to reproduce the eps_theta collapse reported in the denoising-target analysis
